name: agent-wars
description: Grand strategy wargame with LLM opponents on a real-Earth H3 hex map, its code written entirely by coding agents

scripts.build: npm run generated:extract && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: npm run rebuild:native:node && npm run build:main && npm run lint && npm run naming:check && npm run check:renderer-types && node scripts/run-main-node-tests.cjs && npm run notices:check
scripts.verify:modularization: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run lint && npm run check:renderer-types && npm run check:circular && node scripts/run-main-node-tests.cjs --manifest scripts/verify-modularization-tests.manifest
scripts.start: npm run generated:extract && npm run rebuild:native:electron && electron .
scripts.ui:smoke: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native:electron && node scripts/ui-smoke/ui-smoke.cjs
scripts.orienting-comments:dry-run: npm run build:orienting-comments && node dist/scripts/orienting-comments/cli.js dry-run
scripts.orienting-comments:apply: npm run build:orienting-comments && node dist/scripts/orienting-comments/cli.js apply
scripts.naming:report: npm run build:naming && node dist/scripts/naming/cli.js report
scripts.naming:apply: npm run build:naming && node dist/scripts/naming/cli.js apply
scripts.naming:check: npm run build:naming && node dist/scripts/naming/cli.js check
scripts.test:naming: npm run build:naming && node dist/scripts/naming/namingRules.test.js && node dist/scripts/naming/applyRename.test.js
scripts.clean:dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path').join(process.cwd(),'dist');if(fs.existsSync(p)){try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,maxRetries:3,retryDelay:200});}catch(e){console.error('dist/ in use. Close processes locking it, then retry.');process.exit(1);}}"
scripts.terrain:generate: npm run terrain:generate:metadata && npm run terrain:generate:road-rail
scripts.clean:release: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path').join(process.cwd(),'release');if(fs.existsSync(p)){try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,maxRetries:3,retryDelay:200});}catch(e){console.error('Release folder in use. Close the app and any tools using release/, then retry.');process.exit(1);}}"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run generated:assert-pack-ready && npm run rebuild:native:electron && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean:release && npm run build && npm run generated:assert-pack-ready && npm run rebuild:native:electron && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run clean:release && npm run build && npm run generated:assert-pack-ready && npm run rebuild:native:electron && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux
scripts.dist:mac: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') { console.error('Build for macOS is supported only on macOS. Run npm run dist:mac on a Mac. See .spec/packaging.md'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run clean:release && npm run build && npm run generated:assert-pack-ready && npm run rebuild:native:electron && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
